readerCopy.body: The option with the biggest audience, easiest credibility, or most familiar version of success can pull attention away from a less practiced direction. When Jupiter opposes the North Node, established expertise and future growth face each other directly, making the known path especially rewarding because its advantages are already understood. Familiar success can still be useful. It becomes limiting when the reward leaves no time, money, or choice for the newer direction it was supposed to support.
